observed.pullPolicyAmendment: Recorded under ruling R7 (the template carried image.workspace.pullPolicy). Ruling R16 replaced it after this run: the container built-ins now carry Kubernetes' default for their own image (Always for a digest-less latest or empty tag, else IfNotPresent) and ignore image.workspace.pullPolicy. This run's non-latest Tilt tag gives IfNotPresent under both rules, so the observation stands; an install that pins a tag now keeps IfNotPresent, as before A2b (tests/test_workspace_builtin_templates_helm.py)
